card.name: Section headings after numbered subsections
card.fires_on: The first word of a new numbered section heading such as Preparation, Administration or Effect, right after a number like 2.4 or 7.2 in drug label text. Weaker on a few other words, such as bottle or the end of metformin.

modes.label: Numbered section heading
modes.description: First word of a heading right after a section number like 2.4 or 7.2.

modes.label: Other scattered words
modes.description: Occasional drug-name endings or container words in running text.
